OBJECT Codeunit 50024 Builtin Name Conflict
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=28.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      WorkDateG@1000 : Date;

    PROCEDURE GetValueAsTime@1(ValueP@1000 : DateTime) TimeL : Time;
    VAR
      CounterL@1001 : Integer;
    BEGIN
      TimeL := DT2TIME(ValueP);
      WorkDateG := WORKDATE();
      CounterL := 1;
      MESSAGE('%1 %2', TimeL, CounterL);
    END;

    PROCEDURE CheckWorkDate@2();
    BEGIN
      IF WorkDateG = 0D THEN
        EXIT;
    END;

    BEGIN
    END.
  }
}
